noticias.titulo: AI Stock Sell-Off Was A ‘Positioning Reset,’ Not Start Of AI Investment Downturn, Says UBS — Sees $1.5 Trillion Spending In 2028
noticias.resumo:
## Where UBS Sees Investment Opportunities

UBS recommends maintaining exposure to the structural AI opportunity while managing excessive concentration in individual technology stocks.  "We favor established technology platforms with existing computing capacity, visible AI revenues, strong balance sheets, and the ability to finance investment internally," the firm said. 

At the time of this writing, the Nasdaq-100 was marginally in the green.
